This position serves as the Physical Environment Program Administrator within the UC Davis Health Office of Environmental Health & Safety (EH&S) and as a healthcare subject matter expert for Joint Commission-based physical environment programs across the UC system. Working independently under the general direction of the Associate Director of EH&S, the incumbent leads the UC Davis Health clinical safety rounding program, including coordination of inspection activities and implementation of data-driven safety improvements. The position also supports the Safety Committee, serves as the Integrated Pest Management Program Lead, and participates in the EH&S Administrator on Duty (AOD) rotation to provide 24/7 emergency response support.
